title: Local and cosmic-microwave estimates of the expansion rate disagree
summary: Riess and colleagues' 2022 local measurement and the Planck 2018 analysis are different published estimates. The gap is not settled.
body: Adam G. Riess and colleagues published in 2022 "A Comprehensive Measurement of the Local Value of the Hubble Constant with 1 km/s/Mpc Uncertainty from the Hubble Space Telescope and the SH0ES Team." The Planck Collaboration's 2018 analysis infers cosmological parameters, including an expansion rate, from the cosmic microwave background. These are different methods and they have not been brought into a single agreed number. Whether the gap is unrecognized measurement error or a sign that the simple ΛCDM model is incomplete is not settled. This card does not pick a winner and does not quote a kilometer-per-second figure beyond what is already in the Riess title's uncertainty phrase.
